meta.title: In-Platform Stakeholder Collaboration: refused for a user without the AP Executive / Buyer / Vendor role
gaps: Open or locate a dispute case and use In-Platform Stakeholder Collaboration to comment and collaborate.
Sign in as a user without the AP Executive, Buyer, or Vendor role and verify the action is refused or absent.
Repeat the same action as an AP Executive, Buyer, or Vendor and verify it is available.
Verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan or compare the tenant's RBAC configuration.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open or locate a dispute case and use In-Platform Stakeholder Collaboration to comment and collaborate.; Sign in as a user without the AP Executive, Buyer, or Vendor role and verify the action is refused or absent.; Repeat the same action as an AP Executive, Buyer, or Vendor and verify it is available.; Verify that the tenant is on the Growth plan or compare the tenant's RBAC configuration.

args.need: sign in as a user without the AP Executive, Buyer, or Vendor role, open a dispute case, test In-Platform Stakeholder Collaboration by commenting and collaborating, then repeat as an AP Executive, Buyer, or Vendor and record whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access dispute cases, perform stakeholder collaboration, or switch between role-specific user sessions.
Record that the current screen remains free of visible application errors after the tester's role comparison.
